title: More Identification of Persons
subject: English Language
objectives: Ask and answer questions about people's names

blocks.caption: The teacher asks for their names.

blocks.md: We use **'His'** for a boy or man. We use **'Her'** for a girl or woman.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Aisha, what is the name of the pupil in the first row?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Jibril, what is the name of the Headmaster?

lines.speaker: Jibril
lines.text: The Headmaster's name is Mr. Terver, sir.

blocks.md: **Tip:** If the person is a boy, say **'His name is...'** If the person is a girl, say **'Her name is...'**

quiz.q: Ngozi is a girl. What do you say?
Mohammed is a boy. What do you say?
If you ask a girl her name, she says:
quiz.explain: You say 'My name' when talking about yourself.
